description_en: Queries the basic information of a domain name by instance ID
description_zh: 调用QueryDomainByInstanceId根据域名实例编号查询域名的基本信息
name: QueryDomainByInstanceId

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the user. You can set this parameter to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the domain name. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67712.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 域名实例编号，通过查询域名列表https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67712.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

CnnicPrivacyServiceStatus.description_en: The CNNIC registry privacy protection status

DomainGroupId.description_en: The ID of the domain name group. You can obtain the ID by calling the QueryDomainGroupList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html) operation
DomainGroupId.description_zh: 域名分组ID，可通过QueryDomainGroupList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html)接口获取

DomainGroupName.description_en: The name of the domain name group

DomainLifecycleStatus.description_en: The lifecycle status of the domain name. Possible values include REGISTRATION_GRACE_PERIOD (registration grace period), ACTIVE (active), RENEWAL_GRACE_PERIOD (renewal grace period), REDEMPTION_PERIOD (redemption period), PENDING_DELETE (pending delete), and EXPIRED (expired). Enum values may be extended. Do not implement business logic based solely on the current values
DomainLifecycleStatus.description_zh: 域名生命周期状态。可能的取值包括 REGISTRATION_GRACE_PERIOD（注册宽限期）、ACTIVE（正常状态）、RENEWAL_GRACE_PERIOD（续费宽限期）、REDEMPTION_PERIOD（赎回期）、PENDING_DELETE（待删除期）、EXPIRED（已过期）。枚举值可能扩展，请勿仅依赖当前取值实现业务逻辑

DomainNameProxyService.description_en: Indicates whether the domain name privacy protection service is enabled
DomainNameProxyService.description_zh: 是否已开启域名隐私保护服务

DomainNameVerificationStatus.description_en:
The verification status of the domain name. Valid values:
NONAUDIT: Not verified.
SUCCEED: Verified.
FAILED: Verification failed.
AUDITING: Under verification
DomainNameVerificationStatus.description_zh:
域名命名审核状态。取值：
NONAUDIT：未认证。
SUCCEED：成功。
FAILED：审核失败。
AUDITING：审核中。

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain name. Valid values:

1: Renewal urgently required.                                 
2: Redemption urgently required.                                 
3: Normal
DomainStatus.description_zh:
域名状态。取值：

1：急需续费。                                 
2：急需赎回。                                 
3：正常

DomainType.description_en:
The type of the domain name. Valid values:

New gTLD.                                 
gTLD.                                 
ccTLD
DomainType.description_zh:
域名类型。取值：

New gTLD。                                 
gTLD。                                 
ccTLD

Email.description_en: The email address of the domain name owner

EmailVerificationClientHold.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name resolution is suspended. Valid values:

false: The domain name resolution is not suspended.
true: The domain name resolution is suspended
EmailVerificationClientHold.description_zh:
域名是否被暂停解析。取值：

false：域名未被暂停解析。
true：域名已被暂停解析

EmailVerificationStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the email address of the domain name registrant is verified. Valid values:
0: Not verified.
1: Verified
EmailVerificationStatus.description_zh:
域名持有者邮箱是否已通过验证。取值：
0：没有通过验证。
1：已通过验证。

ExpirationCurrDateDiff.description_en: The difference in days between the expiration date of the domain name and the current time
ExpirationCurrDateDiff.description_zh: 域名到期日和当前的时间的天数差值

ExpirationDate.description_en: The expiration time of the queried domain name. The time format varies based on the site and the Lang parameter. For the China site, the format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss in the default time zone of the service runtime. For the International site, if Lang is set to zh, the format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (UTC). If Lang is set to en or other values, the format is MMM dd,yyyy HH:mm:ss (UTC)
ExpirationDate.description_zh: 查询的域名到期时间。时间格式按调用站点和 Lang 决定：国内站为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用服务运行时默认时区；国际站 Lang=zh 为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss（UTC），Lang=en 或其他值为 MMM dd,yyyy HH:mm:ss（UTC）

ExpirationDateLong.description_en: The timestamp of the expiration time

ExpirationDateStatus.description_en:
The expiration status of the domain name. Valid values:
1: The domain name is not expired.
2: The domain name is expired
ExpirationDateStatus.description_zh:
域名过期状态。取值：
1：域名未过期。
2：域名已过期。

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the domain name

Premium.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name is a premium word. Valid values:
true: The domain name is a premium word.
false: The domain name is not a premium word
Premium.description_zh:
是否是溢价词。取值：
true：溢价词。
false：非溢价词

PrivacyServiceStatus.description_en: The domain name privacy service status

RealNameStatus.description_en:
The real-name verification status of the domain name. Valid values:
NONAUDIT: Real-name verification not performed.
SUCCEED: Real-name verification succeeded.
FAILED: Real-name verification failed.
AUDITING: Real-name verification in progress.

The real-name verification status is a combination of the domain name verification status and the real-name verification status. Real-name verification is considered successful only when both verifications pass
RealNameStatus.description_zh:
域名实名认证状态。取值：
NONAUDIT：未实名认证。
SUCCEED：实名认证成功。
FAILED：实名认证审核失败。
AUDITING：实名认证审核中。

域名实名认证状态是域名命名审核和实名审核的组合状态，只有域名命名审核和实名审核均通过才算域名实名认证成功

RegistrantOrganization.description_en: The registrant of the domain name

RegistrantType.description_en:
The type of the domain name registrant. Valid values:
1: Individual.
2: Enterprise
RegistrantType.description_zh:
域名注册联系人类型。取值：
1：个人。
2：企业。

RegistrantUpdatingStatus.description_en:
The modification status of the domain name registrant. Valid values:
PENDING: The registrant information is being modified.
NORMAL: Normal
RegistrantUpdatingStatus.description_zh:
域名持有者修改状态。取值：
PENDING：域名持有者信息修改中。
NORMAL：正常

RegistrationDate.description_en: The registration time of the domain name. The time format varies based on the site and the Lang parameter. For the China site, the format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss in the default time zone of the service runtime. For the International site, if Lang is set to zh, the format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss (UTC). If Lang is set to en or other values, the format is MMM dd,yyyy HH:mm:ss (UTC)
RegistrationDate.description_zh: 域名注册时间。时间格式按调用站点和 Lang 决定：国内站为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，使用服务运行时默认时区；国际站 Lang=zh 为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss（UTC），Lang=en 或其他值为 MMM dd,yyyy HH:mm:ss（UTC）

RegistrationDateLong.description_en: The timestamp of the registration time

Remark.description_en: The remark of the domain name

TransferOutStatus.description_en:
The transfer-out status of the domain name. Valid values:
NORMAL: Normal.
PENDING: Being transferred out of Alibaba Cloud
TransferOutStatus.description_zh:
域名转出状态。取值：
NORMAL：正常。
PENDING：正在转出阿里云。

TransferProhibitionLock.description_en:
The status of the lock that applies when you transfer a domain name to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:
NONE_SETTING: Settings are not configured.
OPEN: Enabled.
CLOSE: shutdown
TransferProhibitionLock.description_zh:
域名转移锁状态。取值：
NONE_SETTING：未设置。
OPEN：已开启。
CLOSE：已关闭。

UpdateProhibitionLock.description_en:
The status of the update prohibition lock. Valid values:
NONE_SETTING: Not configured.
OPEN: Enabled.
CLOSE: Disabled
UpdateProhibitionLock.description_zh:
域名安全锁状态。取值：
NONE_SETTING：未设置。
OPEN：已开启。
CLOSE：已关闭。

UserId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID (Alibaba Cloud account UID)
UserId.description_zh: 阿里云用户编号（阿里云账号UID）

The Chinese name of the contact.

This parameter is applicable only to the China site

The Chinese name of the domain name registrant.
